justification: HOLY COW, folks, six-and-one and we are NOT fixin' what ain't broken! Aaron Rodgers stays right there under center -- future Hall of Famer, slingin' it like it's 2011, and I don't care that Lamar's sittin' there with a shinier projection, you don't bench a legend to chase a number! Bijan's runnin' like he's late for a train and Swift's my Chicago guy carryin' the rock up in CHI, so those boys are locked in regardless. Zay Flowers after that 23-spot is an automatic call, and I'm sliding Stefon Diggs in for Jordan Addison this week -- Addison's a nice young fella but Diggs is a NAME, folks, a name you want in your lineup card on a Sunday. Hockenson and ol' Hunter Henry round out the pass-catchers, Boswell's hot as a Pittsburgh summer at kicker, and the Ravens D rides along even after that rough one -- a little rain never hurt anybody, and besides, it's the only arm I got in the bullpen there! Good luck to Georgie boy, he's gonna need it!
forum_post: HOLY COW Georgie, marquee matchup number two and I am FIRED UP! Nobody's thinkin' about you THAT much, pal, but I love a fella who swings anyway! Got Bijan runnin' like a train, Zay Flowers comin' off a 23-burger, my Chicago kid Swift totin' the rock, and Aaron Rodgers -- future Hall of Famer, don't care what the kids say -- slingin' it around like it's 2011! Swapped Stefon Diggs in this week too 'cause that's just a fun name to root for, folks! Six-and-one feels pretty good from up here in the booth -- good luck Sunday, Georgie, swing away!
